title: Too many options
body: Too many options with app-specific vocabulary, lots of visual clutter, menus that don’t quite make sense or have no context (why would a yellow smiling circle be a button just to show me my name?), extra clutter to tell you about features that don’t even exist yet, the foundations of the app want you to make goals for the future… are you sure this is made for people with ADHD? This was exceptionally more difficult and far more stressful than apps geared towards neurotypical brains, never mind ones that are meant to help with ADHD.
author: AmericanHowl

title: Self guided
body: If you have the ability to understand what you want to achieve, this is the app for you. Step by step movement to getting you to where you want to be.
author: Bellettsa
